integrity: Analytical proof supplied; finite standard-library exact rational checks are supplementary, not a substitute for proof. Published author and earlier exact cycle classification credited.
scientific_limitations: Only equilateral triangles with entire supporting lines and the specified farthest-projection tie convention; no claims for general triangles. Prior work already classifies the existence of the two primitive three-cycles. Directional density concerns a one-sided arclength ray, not symmetric two-sided truncation. Independent mathematical audit not performed.
title: Exact dyadic basins and oscillating directional densities for equilateral farthest projections
